mapper.sql: SELECT a.agent_id, a.created_at AS created_at, a.name, a.description, COALESCE(v.version_count, 0) AS version_count, v.latest_version_number, v.latest_definition, v.latest_published_at, NULL::text AS join_tenant_id FROM agent a JOIN tenant_agent_binding b ON b.agent_id = a.agent_id AND b.tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND b.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS version_count, MAX(av.version_number) AS latest_version_number, (ARRAY_AGG(av.definition ORDER BY av.version_number DESC))[1] AS latest_definition, MAX(av.published_at) AS latest_published_at FROM agent_version av WHERE av.agent_id = a.agent_id ) v ON true WHERE TRUE
mapper.select: SELECT av.version_id, av.version_number, av.definition, av.published_at, av.created_at FROM agent_version av WHERE av.agent_id = #{agentId}::uuid AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tenant_agent_binding b WHERE b.tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND b.agent_id = av.agent_id AND b.status = 'ACTIVE') ORDER BY av.version_number DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM agent_version av WHERE av.agent_id = #{agentId}::uuid AND av.published_at IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tenant_agent_binding b WHERE b.tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND b.agent_id = av.agent_id AND b.status = 'ACTIVE')
